scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the ratio using the exact analytic formula for harmonic oscillator partition functions and compares each agent-reported value with absolute tolerance; also verifies structural trends (above classical ratio, monotonic).

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent ratio of deuterium to hydrogen diffusion coefficients computed from the lattice-deformation-assisted jump model with harmonic oscillator partition functions.

output_contract.notes: The absolute diffusion coefficients D_H and D_D are not reproduced; only their ratio is targeted. The specified vibrational frequencies are taken as given and need not be refit to solubility data.
